analysis:
Only BASE text of .github/workflows/release-provider.yml (lines 1-1060) and a truncated patch excerpt were supplied. The head-side changed regions (head 280-315, 346-356, 989-1071, 1126-1136) are not visible, so the new behavior is not verified.

Visible patch changes: (1) header comments adding DEV/STAGING/PROD_CLUSTER_RUNTIME_ENABLED repository variables, which gate sending cluster_runtime facts with release registration (CLUSTER_RUNTIME_SEND in build-and-release); (2) the qualify-sdk job is split into a qualify-sdk-shard matrix (shard plan from scripts/provider-test-shards.py), with a job still named qualify-sdk described as the single qualification result read by signing and by scripts/provider_release_resume/identity.py; (3) a comment rename.

Base controls reviewed and relevant to A-011, A-017, T-034, T-054 and TB-011: resolve-env verifies reviewed workflow source from master before credentials; per-environment secrets are blanked unless the resolved environment matches; the build-and-release `if` requires build-provider and qualify-sdk to be 'success' (or both skipped on resume); signing validates the unsigned artifact against source SHA and version; the final signed bytes are smoked; CDHash and binary hash are computed and a publication artifact is retained.

No regression is identifiable from the visible evidence. Questions for the next pass, using head text: (a) the aggregator qualify-sdk must use `if: always()` and fail on any shard failure, cancellation or skip, since a skipped or neutral aggregator would break the build-and-release gate or the resume check in identity.py; (b) the shard plan must cover every suite, so no qualification test is silently dropped; (c) the new CLUSTER_RUNTIME_SEND step at head 280-315 must keep per-environment variables isolated, must not leak secrets, and must send only facts computed from the final signed app; (d) the head 989-1071 changes in the registration or publication steps must keep the exact-artifact binding. These conclusions are unverified.
